data.action: 低头全神贯注弹奏电吉他，发丝随激烈演奏飘扬
data.description: 【后藤一里 · STARRY 舞台觉醒】下北泽 STARRY 的地下舞台上，眩目的聚光灯如潮水般打在身上。后藤一里深吸一口气，抱紧怀中的黑金电吉他，手指在指板上如幻影般飞舞，奏出撕裂全场的失真SOLO——「虽然我还是那么害怕社交……但这一刻在舞台上，我想要把心中的全部声音，传达给每一个人！」
data.lighting: 炫目舞台顶光与侧面冷蓝射灯
data.promptProse: Hitori grips her black-and-gold Gibson Les Paul on the STARRY basement stage, drawing a breath before her fingers race along the fretboard through the solo. Her black Kessoku Band T-shirt, dark skirt and red wristband remain clear in the dynamic low medium view. Stage equipment recedes behind. Brilliant top lights catch the guitar hardware and pink hair, while a cool-blue side spotlight separates her sleeve from the dark amplifier.
data.title: 后藤一里 · STARRY 舞台觉醒
